not-enough-text.title: Not enough text to analyse
not-enough-text.fix: Add more content — a full CV usually runs 300+ words; make sure your upload extracted correctly.

missing-experience-section.title: No experience section found
missing-experience-section.fix: Add a clearly labelled Experience (or Work History) section listing your roles.

missing-education-section.title: No education section found
missing-education-section.fix: Add a clearly labelled Education section, even if it's brief.

missing-skills-section.title: No skills section found
missing-skills-section.fix: Add a Skills section listing your key technical and professional skills.

sections-complete.title: All core sections present
sections-complete.fix: Keep Experience, Education, and Skills clearly labelled and easy to find.

missing-email.title: No email address found
missing-email.fix: Add a professional email address near the top of your CV.

missing-phone.title: No phone number found
missing-phone.fix: Add a phone number so recruiters can reach you directly.

missing-linkedin.title: No LinkedIn URL found
missing-linkedin.fix: Add a link to your LinkedIn profile in your contact details.

contact-complete.title: Contact details complete
contact-complete.fix: Keep your email, phone, and LinkedIn URL up to date and visible.

inconsistent-date-formats.title: Date formats are inconsistent
inconsistent-date-formats.fix: Use one consistent date format throughout, e.g. "Jan 2023 – Mar 2024".

missing-dates.title: Some roles are missing dates
missing-dates.fix: Add start and end dates (or "Present") to every role and qualification.

not-reverse-chronological.title: Roles aren't in reverse-chronological order
not-reverse-chronological.fix: List your most recent role first, working backwards through your history.

dates-consistent.title: Dates are consistent and ordered
dates-consistent.fix: Keep new roles at the top and formats consistent as you update your CV.

too-short.title: Your CV looks too short
too-short.fix: Add more detail to your experience and skills — aim for at least one full page.

too-long.title: Your CV runs to about {pages} pages
too-long.fix: Trim to 1–2 pages by cutting older or less relevant roles and tightening bullets.

length-good.title: Length is well-calibrated
length-good.fix: Keep it around 1–2 pages as you add new experience.

weak-bullet-verbs.title: {percent}% of your bullets start with weak verbs
weak-bullet-verbs.fix: Swap passive phrases like "responsible for" for strong action verbs like "led", "built", or "cut".

unquantified-bullets.title: {percent}% of your bullets have no numbers
unquantified-bullets.fix: Add metrics — %, $, time saved, team size — to show the scale of your impact.

bullets-strong.title: Bullets are strong and quantified
bullets-strong.fix: Keep leading with action verbs and backing claims with numbers.

bullets-not-detected.title: No bullet points detected
bullets-not-detected.fix: List your achievements as short bullet points (one line each) instead of paragraphs — it's easier for recruiters and ATS software to scan.

possible-table-layout.title: Possible table or column layout detected
possible-table-layout.fix: Avoid tables, text boxes, and multi-column layouts — many ATS parsers read them out of order or skip them.

special-characters.title: Unusual characters found
special-characters.fix: Remove icons, emojis, and special symbols that ATS parsers can't read reliably.

ats-clean.title: No ATS parsing red flags
ats-clean.fix: Keep your layout simple — single column, standard fonts, no embedded graphics.

low-keyword-match.title: Low keyword match — {matched} of {total} terms found
low-keyword-match.fix: Work more of the job posting's key terms and skills naturally into your experience and skills sections.

moderate-keyword-match.title: Moderate keyword match — {matched} of {total} terms found
moderate-keyword-match.fix: You're partway there — mirror a few more of the job posting's exact terms to close the gap.

strong-keyword-match.title: Strong keyword match — {matched} of {total} terms found
strong-keyword-match.fix: Great alignment — keep this level of overlap for other roles you apply to.

locale-photo-note.title: Photo not expected
locale-photo-note.fix: In most English-speaking job markets, CV photos aren't expected — leave it out unless specifically requested.

locale-personal-details.title: Skip unnecessary personal details
locale-personal-details.fix: Leave out marital status, date of birth, and national ID numbers — they're not expected and can invite bias.

locale-length-note.title: Keep it concise
locale-length-note.fix: 1–2 pages is the norm in most English-speaking markets — trim older or less relevant experience.

conventions-ok.title: Follows regional conventions
conventions-ok.fix: Keep matching what's expected in your target market as you apply elsewhere.
